plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-nsfc-form-check — NSFC proposal form review and identity-clue prompting against the institution's own roster

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-nsfc-form-check
```


[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-nsfc-form-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-nsfc-form-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-nsfc-form-check` reads one NSFC proposal — its body lines, its electronic document properties, and the institution's own roster of identity terms — and checks that material against a versioned rule pack: whether a roster is configured at all, where the configured applicant, institution and advisor terms occur in the body and inside a configured line range, what the title, author, company and last-modified-by properties carry, whether the material fits the length limit the deployment set, whether the configured form-review items and duplicate-application disclosure are present, whether the advisor's name has been filled in as the yearly guidelines require, and whether any configured classified or sensitive term appears. Every finding names the clause it came from, states whether that clause is a direct requirement, a principle or a local configuration, and every check that could not run is listed in `skipped` with its reason.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-nsfc-form-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-nsfc-form-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-nsfc-form-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-nsfc-form-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `nsfc_form_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"text":"申请代码：H0301\n项目名称：某信号通路在疾病进展中的作用机制研究","metadata":{},"roster":{"authorNames":[],"institutionNames":[],"advisorNames":[],"allowList":[]}}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-nsfc-form-check.NF-001.811c9dc5",
  "ruleId": "NF-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {},
  "found": "未配置任何可核验的身份词（申请人姓名、依托单位名称、导师姓名均为空）",
  "expected": "匿名检查需要名单才能执行；未配置时其余匿名相关检查只能逐条报为未执行"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-nsfc-form-check/tests/fixtures/NF-001/NF-001-unsafe.json`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| Nobody filled in the applicant name list. Does the identity checking just pass? | No. `NF-001` is the first thing reported when `authorNames`, `institutionNames` and `advisorNames` are all empty, and every identity check that needs those terms reports itself in `skipped` with its reason. An empty finding list therefore never means nothing was wrong — read `NF-001` and the `skipped` entries before drawing any conclusion. |
| A co-author with the same surname as the applicant appears in the body text. | `NF-002` matches the configured `authorNames` literally, line by line, so a namesake, a common surname or a citation of another researcher's work can all be reported. The finding is a technical prompt only — 《国家自然科学基金条例》(国务院令第796号) 第二十一条 requires confidentiality from reviewers and says nothing that forbids a name in the body — so a term you have already cleared can be added to `allowList`. |
| The author property holds a name. Is that reported, and does it need a configured list? | Yes, and no. `NF-006` does not need a roster: with `authorNames` empty it still reports any non-empty author property, and with a roster configured it says whether the value matches an applicant name. `NF-005`, `NF-007` and `NF-008` do need an identity-term list and enter `skipped` without one. All four only read the properties, so they say nothing about the body text. |
| I filled in the page and word limits myself. Will it tell me the proposal is too long? | Only within the limit you set. `NF-010` ships `maxLines` and `maxChars` unset and enters `skipped`, because those limits change every year and by project type; once you fill them in it reports the extracted paragraph count or the character total that exceeds them. `maxLines` counts extracted paragraphs, not typeset pages, so it is not the same as a page count. |
| Did the material include every form-review item our research office asks for? | `NF-011` reports itself in `skipped` until `require` is configured, and with no checklist the plugin does not pretend to know one. Once configured it matches your `match` phrases literally and reports the ones it cannot find. It checks that the phrase is present, not that the column was filled in correctly or that the signature is genuine. |
| We are re-submitting last year's proposal. Must the disclosure note be there? | `NF-012` needs both `markerPatterns`, which recognise your template's wording for a repeat or follow-on application, and `requiredDisclosure`, which lists what must be disclosed. With either unset it enters `skipped`; when the markers are configured but no declaration is found it reports that this rule does not apply. It never assumes a disclosure wording, and never decides that a proposal really is a repeat. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《国家自然科学基金条例》 | 国务院令第796号 | NF-001, NF-002, NF-003, NF-004, NF-005, NF-006, NF-007, NF-008, NF-009, NF-010, NF-011, NF-012, NF-013, NF-014, NF-015 |
| 《2026 年度国家自然科学基金项目指南·申请规定》 | 2026 年度（逐年更新） | NF-014, NF-015 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **NSFC proposal's text and electronic document properties** and
reports the identity clues it finds, alongside the length and form-review items a deployment
configures. It is not `dsh-rulefile-check` (which audits the legality of a regulatory document), not
`dsh-policy-brief-draft` (which drafts a policy explainer), and not `dsh-review-reply-check` (which
tracks reviewer comments). It reads one proposal and reports literal matches against cited clauses.

> ### ⚠️ Read this before using the anonymity checks
>
> **There is no current national provision that forbids an applicant's name, institution or advisor
> from appearing in an NSFC proposal.** Three independent texts were read in full for this plugin —
> 《国家自然科学基金条例》(国务院令第796号), the 2026 年度《项目指南·申请规定》, and the 2019 年度
> guidelines — and none contains 匿名, 盲审, 活页, or any "must not appear" wording about identity.
> The regulation does not contain the word 匿名 at all. Its **avoidance** clause (第二十条) requires a
> reviewer from the applicant's own legal entity to recuse, which presupposes that the system knows
> the applicant's institution — the opposite of an anonymous process.
>
> So every finding this plugin makes about a name or an institution is a **technical observation for
> a human to weigh**, labelled 身份线索词 and never phrased as a violation. The plugin is useful for a
> research-office self-check, and it is **wrong to use it as a compliance gate**. Two rules go further
> and cite the guidance verbatim: `NF-014` checks that the advisor's name **is** filled in, because the
> yearly guidelines require it, and `NF-015` checks 涉密与敏感信息, which is the one "must not appear"
> requirement that really exists — and its object is classified information, not identity.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for a batch of proposals use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `nsfc_form_check` tool. It reads one proposal — body text, document properties, and the
institution's own roster of identity terms — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report in
which every finding names the clause it c

plugins.description: Blazing fast Rust-native linter for Odoo modules
plugins.readme_text:
odoo-lint

Blazing fast Rust-native linter for Odoo modules. The command is called `odl`. It checks Python files, manifests, XML and CSV data files and translation (`.po`) files, with the checks of OCA's pylint-odoo, `oca-checks-odoo-module` and `oca-checks-po`: same names, same messages, same results on their own test suites. It also warns about files that do not belong in a module, such as packages or database dumps committed by accident.

Linting all of OCA/sale-workflow 18.0, as OCA's pre-commit hook runs pylint-odoo. See benchmarks.

- ⚡ **250x faster** than pylint with pylint-odoo, and still 30x faster on a single core - ⚖️ **Drop-in for pylint-odoo and OCA's pre-commit checks**: same codes, names and messages, 95/95 checks matching on their own test suites (Python, manifests, XML, `.po`), and `# pylint: disable=` comments keep working - 🔧 **Automatic fixes**, safe and unsafe as in Ruff, for Python, manifests, XML and `.po` files (`odl check --fix`, `--diff` to preview) - ⬆️ **Upgrade checks**: leftovers of older Odoo versions, such as Bootstrap 4 classes that do nothing since Odoo 15.0, with fixes - 🌍 **Translation checks that predict Odoo's loader**: why Odoo logs "malformed po file", and why a translation does not show up - 📦 **Installable with pip, uv or pipx**: one binary in prebuilt wheels for Linux, macOS and Windows, without Python dependencies - 🛠️ **Configured in `pyproject.toml`**, including company-specific author rules - 📋 **Output for CI**: GitHub annotations, GitLab Code Quality, SARIF and JSON - ✍️ **In your editor**: a language server (`odl server`) with quick fixes, and extensions for VS Code and Zed - 🤖 **For AI coding agents**: an MCP server, and plugins for Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode that lint every file the agent edits - 🪝 **Git hooks**: pre-commit and hk ## Installation ```bash uv tool install odoo-linter # or: pipx install odoo-linter cargo install odoo-lint # from crates.io ``` The PyPI package is called `odoo-linter`, because `odoo-lint` is too similar to an existing PyPI project. On crates.io it is `odoo-lint`. ## Quick start ```bash odl check path/to/addons # lint a directory odl rule # list all rules odl rule C8101 # explain a rule odl check --fix # apply the safe fixes (--diff to preview) ``` Rules ported from pylint-odoo keep its codes, names and messages, and `# pylint: disable=` comments keep working. Company-specific rules are configured in your `pyproject.toml`: ```toml [tool.odoo-lint] target-version = "17.0" [tool.odoo-lint.rules.manifest-required-author.mapping] "acme_*" = "Acme Corp" ``` For AI coding agents there is an MCP server (`odl mcp`) and a post-edit hook, packaged as plugins for Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add bosd/odoo-lint`), DeepSeek Harness and OpenCode. See the [documentation](https://odoo-lint.readthedocs.io/) for all commands, configuration options and rules. ## Development ```bash uv sync --all-groups # builds odl into .venv via maturin uv run nox # pre-commit, fmt, clippy, cargo tests, CLI tests, docs ``` See the [development guide](https://odoo-lint.readthedocs.io/en/latest/development.html). ## License MIT

plugins.description: n8n workflow automation tools for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-n8n

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

n8n workflow automation integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) as a Cordis plugin. The agent can inspect workflows, version history, tags, and execution status, and explicitly activate or deactivate one workflow at a time.

## Install

```sh
npm install @libai168/dsh-tool-n8n
```

Requires `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (^4.0.1) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (^0.1.0-rc.6) as peer dependencies.

## Configuration

```yaml
- name: 'github:LJH-snow/dsh-tool-n8n'
  config:
    baseUrl: 'https://n8n.example.com'
    apiKeyEnv: 'N8N_API_KEY'
    # timeoutMs: 15000
```

The plugin reads the n8n public API key from the environment variable named by `apiKeyEnv` (default: `N8N_API_KEY`). Do not put a usable key in source, examples, tests, or committed configuration. Create the key in n8n under **Settings > n8n API** and grant only the permissions required by the deployment.

`baseUrl` defaults to the local instance at `http://localhost:5678`. The endpoint is checked before every request. Link-local addresses (`169.254.0.0/16`, `fe80::/10`, including their IPv4-compatible, IPv4-mapped, and NAT64 forms) and the unspecified address (`0.0.0.0/8`, `::`) are always rejected: they are never a valid n8n address, and they include the cloud metadata address. Self-hosted instances stay usable by default, including loopback and private networks. Set `enforcePublicEndpoint: true` to additionally require a publicly reachable host; that mode also resolves ordinary hostnames and rejects loopback, private, CGNAT, multicast, reserved, and every IANA special-purpose range.

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Write |
|---|---|---|
| `n8n_auth_test` | Verify the API key without returning it | No |
| `n8n_list_workflows` | List workflows with cursor, active, and name filters | No |
| `n8n_get_workflow` | Read one workflow's metadata and settings summary | No |
| `n8n_list_workflow_versions` | List workflow version-history metadata with cursor pagination | No |
| `n8n_get_workflow_tags` | Read metadata for tags attached to one workflow | No |
| `n8n_list_executions` | List execution status records without execution payload data | No |
| `n8n_get_execution` | Read one execution status record without payload data | No |
| `n8n_stop_execution` | Stop one running execution | Yes |
| `n8n_retry_execution` | Retry one execution and report the new execution | Yes |
| `n8n_activate_workflow` | Publish/activate one workflow | Yes |
| `n8n_deactivate_workflow` | Unpublish/deactivate one workflow | Yes |

## Security contract

- API keys are read from an environment variable at plugin startup and are never included in tool output or rendered text.
- Workflow credentials, node definitions, connections, and execution payload data are intentionally not returned by the client mapping layer.
- Write operations are single-workflow operations and are marked `kind: 'edit'`; there are no bulk, delete, credential, or workflow-definition mutation tools.
- The client passes caller cancellation signals through to `fetch` and uses a 15-second timeout by default.
- API failures are normalized into `{ ok: false, reason }` or `{ found: false, reason }` tool results.

## API scope

This version uses the n8n public API for workflow metadata, version-history metadata, workflow tags, execution inspection, execution stop/retry, and workflow publish/unpublish (the current API names for activation/deactivation). Version history and tag responses are mapped to metadata only; workflow definitions, nodes, credentials, connections, and execution payloads are not returned. The public API has no endpoint for triggering a workflow run (only stop/retry of existing executions), so explicit webhook triggering is out of scope; workflow-definition updates are also not covered.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm pack --dry-run
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Translation plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a two-pane Translate page to the sidebar with model, reasoning effort and prompt controls.
plugins.readme_text:
# 🌐 dsh-translate-tab **A translation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-translate-tab?color=4d6bfe)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-translate-tab) [![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek_Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](#-installation) [![15 languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-15-orange)](#languages) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178c6)](#-architecture) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/zhen-bo/dsh-translate-tab) [Installation](#-installation) · [Quick start](#-quick-start) · [Usage](#-usage) · [Troubleshooting](#-troubleshooting) English | [繁體中文](docs/README.zh-TW.md)
![The Translate page in DeepSeek Harness. English source text on the left, detected automatically and translated into Traditional Chinese on the right.](docs/screenshot-dark.png) ## ✨ Features - **Sidebar integration:** adds a Translate entry under Plugins that opens a two-pane translation view in the main area. - **Shared model catalog:** uses the same providers and models as Harness chat, with adjustable reasoning effort. - **Low-latency default:** uses the catalog's default model with reasoning effort off. - **15 languages:** with automatic source language detection. - **Configurable prompt:** supports `{{target_language}}`, `{{source_language}}` and `{{text}}` variables. - **Localized interface:** follows the Harness language setting in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. ## 📋 Requirements - DeepSeek Harness desktop app with the `dsh` CLI on `PATH` - At least one model configured with a valid API key in Settings › Models ## 📦 Installation ### From DSH Plugin Hub 1. Install DSH Plugin Hub: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin ``` 2. Restart DeepSeek Harness. 3. Open **Settings › Plugin Market**, search for `dsh-translate-tab` and select **Install**. ### From npm 1. Install the plugin from the npm registry: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-translate-tab ``` 2. Restart DeepSeek Harness. ### From GitHub 1. Install the plugin from the repository: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:Zhen-Bo/dsh-translate-tab" ``` 2. Restart DeepSeek Harness. ## 🚀 Quick start 1. Open **Plugins › Translate** in the sidebar. 2. Enter the source text in the left pane. 3. Press Ctrl + Enter, or ⌘ + Enter on macOS. The translation streams into the right pane. ## 🧭 Usage ### Languages Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian and Arabic, each available as source or target. Automatic detection applies to the source and recognizes Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Thai, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English. ### Model and reasoning effort The model picker is at the top right. Reasoning effort is set with the slider below the model list. ### Translation prompt The prompt editor opens from the button next to the model picker. The prompt is sent as the user message with the following variables substituted: | Variable | Value | |---|---| | `{{target_language}}` | Target language name in English, for example `Japanese` | | `{{source_language}}` | Source language name, or `the detected source language` | | `{{text}}` | Source text. Appended to the end when the prompt omits this variable | ### Storage | Data | Location | Lifetime | |---|---|---| | Languages, model, reasoning effort and custom prompt | `localStorage` key `dsh-translate-tab:v1` | Persistent | | Source text draft | `sessionStorage` key `dsh-translate-tab:draft` | Current window session | ## 🔧 Troubleshooting | Message | Resolution | |---|---| | This model has no API key yet | Add a key in Settings › Models, or select another model | | The API key was rejected | Verify the key in Settings › Models | | Too many requests | Retry after a short wait | | The response stopped early | Run the translation again | | Text is too long | Split the source text into segments under 100,000 characters | If Translate is missing under Plugins, verify the install path and restart DeepSeek Harness. ## 🧹 Uninstall ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-translate-tab ``` Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards. ## 🧩 Architecture | Path | Runtime | Role | |---|---|---| | `src/client` | Harness window | Translate page in React and TypeScript | | `src/server` | Harness host | `POST /translate/api/stream`, streams a single model call | | `src/shared` | Both | Route, text limits and stream event types | | `locale` | Harness window | Interface text, registered with the Harness locale service | | `lib` | Both | Build output loaded by Harness |
Stream format
The route accepts same-origin requests from the Harness window and responds with newline-delimited JSON: ```text {"t":"text","v":"..."} translated text {"t":"done"} finished {"t":"aborted"} cancelled {"t":"error","message":"..."} failed ```
## 💻 Development 1. Install dependencies and link the working copy to the desktop profile: ```bash npm install dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:D:/path/to/dsh-translate-tab" ``` 2. Run the build in watch mode, then restart DeepSeek Harness to load changes: ```bash npm run dev ``` | Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `npm run build` | Builds `lib/client.js` and `lib/index.js` | | `npm run check` | Runs the type check, lint, tests and build | | `npm run fix` | Formats the code with gts | ## 📄 License Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH 错误分类修正插件：把适配器一律判成 AUTH 的提供方失败改写为 PROVIDER_ERROR，让网关原文原样显示，而不是被 UI 替换成「API 密钥无效」。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-error-classify

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-1f6feb.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DSH%20Web-4c8bf5.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**DSH 错误分类修正插件** —— 让提供方的原始报错**原样显示**，不再被 UI 替换成一句固定的「API 密钥无效」。

网关说「当前分组下没有可用渠道」，你看到的却是「API 密钥无效」，然后跑去换一个根本没问题的密钥。本插件修掉这个误导。

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lxl8182/dsh-llm-error-classify

# 或从本地目录安装
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-error-classify
```

然后**重启 dsh web**。零依赖、零构建：纯 JavaScript，无 `prepare` 脚本，不需要单独跑 `npm install`。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-llm-error-classify
```

升级 `github:` 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-llm-error-classify`，再重启 dsh web。

## 解决什么问题

pi-ai 适配器只凭**文本**给失败分类（`llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts` 的 `classifyPiAiError`），而它的第一条规则是：

```ts
if (/\b(?:401|403)\b/.test(message)) return 'AUTH'
```

这条规则排在所有更具体的判断**之前**，所以任何 401/403 都变成 `AUTH`——余额耗尽、渠道被禁用、令牌无权使用该模型、IP 未白名单、以及真正的密钥错误，到达 UI 时长得一模一样。

而 `AUTH` 恰好是 UI **唯一拒绝原样渲染**的 code：

| 位置 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `ui-chat/.../conversation-nodes/event-projection.ts` | `if (code === 'AUTH') return { code, message: '' }` — **清空正文** |
| `ui-trajectory/.../trajectory-event-projection.ts` | 同上，第二处 UI 表面 |
| `ui-chat/.../chat/MessageItem.tsx` | `code === 'AUTH'` → 替换为 `message.failure.auth`，即「API 密钥无效」 |
| `ui-trajectory/.../TrajectoryTable.tsx` | `errorCode === 'AUTH'` → 替换为 `details.failure.auth` |

## 它怎么修

挂到 `llm/stream` waterfall（`packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts`）。它包裹适配器原始的 chunk 迭代器，因此能在 agent loop 落盘之前看到终态 `finish` chunk，改写其中的 failure code。改在这里同时修正**持久化会话记录**和 **UI 渲染**。

规则只有一条：**凡 `code === 'AUTH'` 的终态失败，改写成 `PROVIDER_ERROR`，并保留原始文本。**

`PROVIDER_ERROR` 是刻意选的，两个集合都不在里面：

- **不在 UI 特判集合里**（特判集合为 `AUTH`、`QUOTA`、`ACCOUNT_QUOTA`、`ACCOUNT_SIGNED_OUT`、`ACCOUNT_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED`）。UI 的渲染函数对其它一切 code 都直接回落到 `message`／`error`，所以提供方原文原样显示。
- **不在默认可重试集合里**（`retry-policy.ts`：只有 `EMPTY_RESPONSE`、`RATE_LIMIT`、`SERVER`、`TIMEOUT`、`TRANSPORT`）。行为与原先的 `AUTH` 完全一致，不会因此多出重试。

效果对照（`displayFailure` 实测输出）：

```
AUTH           -> {"code":"AUTH","message":""}                      ← 正文被清空
PROVIDER_ERROR -> {"code":"PROVIDER_ERROR","message":"当前分组下没有可用渠道"}
```

不再需要维护任何配额词表：不管网关报的是欠费、渠道还是权限，原文都会显示。这也顺带修掉了原版只认配额措辞、其余网关 403 仍误报密钥无效的盲区。

## 为什么要清洗密钥

上游清空 `AUTH` 正文是**双重目的**的（见 `event-projection.ts` 的注释）：

> Provider AUTH messages may echo a masked or partially preserved credential.
> Keep the raw diagnostic in the Session log, but never retain it in UI state.

它既是为了显示得好看，也是一道**凭证防泄漏**。改写 code 会让原文进入 UI 状态，等于拆掉这道防护，所以插件在放行前先清洗凭证形状的子串（替换为 `[redacted]`）：

- 厂商前缀密钥：`sk-…`、`sk-proj-…`、`ghp_…`、`github_pat_…`、`xoxb-…` 等；
- 消息里回显的 `Bearer <token>`。

**这里是按形状匹配，不是按值匹配**：`GenerateOptions` 不携带凭证（适配器私下解析），插件拿不到真实密钥，因此一个没有任何厂商前缀特征的裸密钥无法被识别。这是本方案已知的残留缺口——若你所用网关会回显此类密钥，请勿依赖本插件的清洗。

## 已知限制

- **不改重试行为**，也不改任何非 `AUTH` 的 code。它只做一件事：`AUTH → PROVIDER_ERROR` 加凭证清洗。
- **凭证清洗按形状匹配**（见上），无厂商前缀的裸密钥识别不了。
- 依赖宿主内部的 code 语义（UI 特判集合、默认可重试集合）。DSH 升级若改动这两个集合，需要跟着调整 `PROVIDER_ERROR_CODE` 的选择。

## 验证

以下命令在**仓库副本**里运行（`dsh plugin add` 装进 profile 的副本只包含运行时文件 `index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`README.md`）。

逻辑层：

```sh
node test.mjs
```

- 正向：网关配额 403、无可用渠道 403、令牌无权 403、真密钥 401 —— 全部 `AUTH → PROVIDER_ERROR`；
- 反向：非 `AUTH` 的 code（`RATE_LIMIT`/`QUOTA`/`SERVER`）原样不动；
- 文本保留：渠道报错原文完整可见；
- 凭证清洗：回显的 `sk-proj-…` 与 `Bearer …` 均被抹掉；
- 结构：非 finish chunk 原样返回、`aborted` 终态同样修正。

端到端（经真实 `llm/stream` waterfall）：

```sh
DSH_REPO=/path/to/dsh-checkout node probe-e2e.mjs
```

探针插件注册一个抛出 `new LlmError(403 网关文本, 'AUTH')` 的适配器，跑 `ctx.llm.stream()`，确认终态 finish chunk 的 code 变成 `PROVIDER_ERROR`、文本保留且密钥已被抹掉。探针通过 `createRequire` 从 dsh 安装目录解析宿主包（`DSH_REPO` 指定该目录，默认为当前目录）。

## 结构

```
index.js          宿主半边：llm/stream waterfall 监听，改写终态 failure
cordis.patch.yml  bundle 层，插入宿主行 llm-error-classify
test.mjs          逻辑层检查
probe-e2e.mjs     端到端探针（需 dsh checkout）
```

## 上游修复建议

根因在宿主，本插件是绕开而非根治。彻底修法是三处小改：

1. `llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`：把 `isQuotaExceededError` 等更具体的判断提到 401/403 分支**之前**，并且不要仅凭「文本里有 403」就判定为认证失败；
2. `llm/src/error.ts` 的 `isQuotaExceededError`：补下划线变体（`insufficient[\s_-]+(?:user[\s_-]+)?quota`）及中文额度措辞；
3. `ui-chat` / `ui-trajectory` 的 `displayFailure`：清空正文应针对「确实回显了凭证」的情况，而不是整个 `AUTH` code——否则真实认证失败之外的一切 401/403 都会被这句固定文案盖掉。

上游修好后本插件可直接卸载。

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin + runtime patch: per-session multi-folder workspace roots from .code-workspace files, multi-root @ completion, user-approved root grants, and a Web Roots tab (macOS Seatbelt)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-harness

LH's adaptation of the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) to the `~/Git/<scope>/*.code-workspace` model, without forking it. Each DSH session gets extra writable roots: the folders its scope's workspace files list outside `~/Git/<scope>/` (phase 1). It gets `@` file completion across all of them (phase 2). The agent can also ask the user to approve one more writable directory for the rest of the session (phase 3). The Web UI gets a Roots tab that browses every root (phase 4).

Strategy, decisions and verified traps live in the vault note `~/Git/Cerebro/LH/20 - Proyectos/Infra-Harness-DSH.md`. The upstream reference clone `~/Git/DevStack/deepseek-harness` is read-only.

## How it works

| Piece | Path | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime pin | `package.json` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` pinned exactly; installed into this repo's `node_modules` (not the npx cache). |
| Multi-root patch | `patch/dsh-multi-root.mjs` | Three exact-anchor hunks on the installed runtime (below). All-or-nothing, idempotent, `--check` / `--revert`. |
| Patch verify | `patch/dsh-multi-root-verify.mjs` | Loads the real installed modules and checks bash (Seatbelt) and fs writes against a temp policy. |
| Policy plugin | `packages/workspace-roots/` (`dsh-lh-workspace-roots`) | Cordis plugin that provides `ctx.sandboxPolicy` in place of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy`. |
| `@` completion plugin | `dsh-lh-workspace-roots/file-references` (same package) | Provides `ctx.fileReferences` in place of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-file-reference-local`, across all roots. |
| Root grants | `src/root-grants.js` (registered by the policy plugin) | The `add_workspace_root` tool and the `workspaceRootGrants` session projection. |
| Directory listings | `dsh-lh-workspace-roots/workspace-files` (same package) | Lets upstream `ctx.workspaceFiles` list and watch directories inside the extra roots. |
| Web Roots tab | `src/client.js` (the package's `./client` bundle) | Right-sidebar tab with one file tree per root. |
| Workspace files | `dsh-lh-workspace-roots/directory-picker`, `src/workspace-selection.js` | Add workspace also opens a `*.code-workspace` file; each session keeps the file that was active when it started. |
| Repo skills | `dsh-lh-workspace-roots/repo-skills` (same package) | Sessions opened from a workspace file also get the `/` skills of its other repos. |
| Launcher | `bin/dsh`, `bin/dsh-node` | Runs the pinned runtime under a Node that satisfies `^22.19 \|\| >=24`. `~/.local/bin/dsh` symlinks here. |
| Bootstrap | `bootstrap.sh` | install → patch → wire profile → launcher → verify. Idempotent; `--revert` undoes it. |

### Per-session roots

`resolve({ session, mode })` takes the session's `cwd`, walks up to `~/Git/<scope>/`, reads every `*.code-workspace` directly in that folder (JSONC; `path` entries relative to the file with `~` expansion, or `file://` `uri` entries), and returns the union of folders that resolve outside the scope folder as `policy.workspaceRoots`. Sessions outside `~/Git` (or at `~/Git` itself) get none.

- Resolution runs on every call. A per-scope cache is keyed on each workspace file's inode, mtime and size, so adding, editing or deleting a file takes effect on the next tool call; folder existence is re-checked every call.
- A malformed file, or one without a `folders` array, logs a warning and contributes nothing; the session keeps running.
- Roots that are `/`, `$HOME` or an ancestor of it, or that contain `~/Git`, are refused with a warning.
- The policy context in the system prompt names the extra roots and the denied paths; without extra roots it is identical to upstream's text.

### Opening a workspace file

A scope often has several workspace files (`DevStack - DSH`, `DevStack - Helm`, …), and the union of all of them is broader than any one task. The Web **Add workspace** button accepts a folder or a `*.code-workspace` file, through the macOS native panel or the browser picker (including remote/SSH launches):

- **A workspace file directly in a scope folder** becomes that scope's *active file*, and its first folder is registered as the DSH workspace (DSH workspaces are directories, one per path), so sessions start there and the session header's "open in" menu opens that repo. When the first folder is not an existing directory inside the scope (or is the scope itself), the scope folder is registered instead. Either way the Workspace is titled after the file (`Radar Insights`, not `seia`): the picker creates the registration in `ctx.workspaceRegistry` with that title, or retitles an existing one, before returning the directory, and the controller's create route then reuses it. Titles are not unique, so an older Workspace of the scope folder with the same name stays until you remove it; renaming in the sidebar still works, until the file is opened again.
- **The scope folder itself** clears the active file: back to the union.
- **Any other folder** is registered unchanged. A workspace file anywhere else is refused with an error.

A session whose cwd lies in one of its workspace file's in-scope folders also gets the file's other in-scope folders as extra roots, because the scope folder that used to contain them is no longer the cwd. A deeper cwd (`seia/src`) also reaches the listed folder above it (`seia`). Sessions using the union of a scope's files never get sibling folders. With an active file set, a folder of that file opened directly through Add workspace behaves the same way.

Each session pins its scope's active file (or the union) the first time its roots are resolved, and keeps it: switching the active file later affects only new sessions, so a running session never gains roots silently. Forks inherit the parent's pin; sessions that existed before this feature pin whatever is active the first time they are resolved after it. A pinned file is re-read on every call; if it is deleted, the session gets no workspace-file roots and a warning is logged.

Active files and pins live in the `dsh_lh_workspace_roots` storage domain (`ctx.storageDomain`), not in the session log; the resulting roots reach the model through the `sandbox:policy` context. The panel replaces `pick` on the live native capability of upstream `ctx.directoryPicker` (directory-picker-auto stays), and disposal restores it. The browse capability replaces the live listing with one scan that puts directories and `.code-workspace` files in the same name-sorted window of `maxEntries` rows (default 1,000). It reads at most `10 * maxEntries` directory entries (default 10,000), counting regular files that are skipped, and closes the handle at the cap. A capped listing is marked truncated and sorted over the inspected prefix; entries beyond that prefix may have earlier names. Files appear as selectable leaves with an empty preview column; choose **Open** to resolve and title the workspace through the same policy as the native panel. The upstream browser currently uses its folder icon for these leaves. The plugin also wraps the live controller’s `create` method for browse selections and restores both overrides on disposal. Other native platforms keep the upstream folder chooser.

### Repo skills in workspace-file sessions

Upstream finds project skills (`/` commands) only in `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills` at the project root of the session cwd. A session opened from a workspace file runs in its first repo (or in the scope folder), so skills defined in the file's other repos would be missing. `dsh-lh-workspace-roots/repo-skills` registers one more `ctx.skills` provider, `lh-workspace-repos`, that scans those two directories in the in-scope folders the session does not already reach, per the scope's active workspace file: every in-scope folder the file lists when the cwd is the scope folder (all of the scope's files when none is active), or the file's other in-scope folders when the cwd lies in one of them. Skill lookups carry only the cwd, so this follows the active file, not the session's pin. Lookups from anywhere else get nothing from it.

Each repo is served by an upstream `FileSystemSkillProvider` limited to its two directories, so parsing

plugins.description: Removable speech enhancements for DeepSeek Harness voice input
plugins.readme_text:
# 语音服务

独立的 DSH 语音增强插件，在官方语音输入上增加静音收尾、自动发送和自动朗读。无需修改官方源码。

启用官方语音输入并准备识别模型后，再启用本插件。在本插件设置中勾选「增强输入框语音」，普通输入框会显示话筒与录音波形。开始说话后，音量持续低于配置阈值达到 1000 毫秒（默认值），就结束录音并调用官方语音识别接口。全程无声音不会提前结束，最长录音时间沿用官方服务限制。

「转写后自动发送」仅在转写成功插入原草稿后提交。录制期间修改草稿造成冲突时，保留转写文字供手动插入；空结果、取消、切换会话和权限失败不会发送。自动朗读只播放启用后的新回复正文，跳过历史、推理、工具调用与中断回复；离开会话、隐藏页面或关闭开关时停止。

官方模型准备仍在官方语音输入设置中。本插件可另外注册多个本地 ASR 模型，与官方识别器共同出现在本插件设置的「识别服务」列表中。朗读需要启用 dsh-rabiroute-agent，并在 Rabi 配置可用的默认 TTS；通过现有 `/rabiroute/speech` 接口请求音频。

## 自定义 ASR 模型

在插件设置点击「添加 ASR 模型」，填写名称、后端、绝对模型路径、Python 可执行文件、设备和支持的语言，保存后在本插件设置选择。可添加多个模型，编辑、停用或移除单项；不删除模型文件。稳定 id 标识每个配置，名称可以重复，id 不可重复。路径属于运行 DSH 的电脑；换电脑后需调整路径和 Python 环境。

支持 [FunASR](https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR) 的 AutoModel 本地目录（例如匹配该接口的 SenseVoice、Paraformer 检查点），以及 [faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) 的 CTranslate2 模型目录。普通 Whisper PyTorch 权重不能直接当作 CTranslate2 模型使用。Python 环境需自行安装所选后端及其依赖；插件不安装 Python、不下载模型、不执行模型目录里的自定义 Python 代码。FunASR 配置关闭 remote code，faster-whisper 使用 local_files_only，子进程设置 Hugging Face 离线模式；需要自定义模型代码的检查点不在本版支持范围。

设备默认为 cpu；faster-whisper 精度默认为 int8。语言必须按具体检查点支持范围填写（auto 表示自动识别），不会根据路径猜测。录音开始时通过官方接口固定识别器和语言；更新模型配置会撤销旧识别器并取消在途识别，不回退到其他模型。并发默认 1，繁忙时明确报错。

每次转写启动一个官方 ctx.subprocess 管理的隐藏 Python 子进程，加载模型、识别、退出并释放内存。不是常驻推理服务，大模型每次加载可能较慢。默认识别超时 300000 毫秒，grace 1000 毫秒，结果限额 131072 字节；可在插件配置修改 workerTimeoutMs、workerGraceMs、maxWorkerOutputBytes、maxConcurrentRecognitions。超时、取消和卸载等待受管进程退出后删除临时音频与结果。Home 的 logs/speech-service 保留每次调用的日志和含 PID、父 PID、用途、来源的记录。

## 逐步退役

官方增加对应能力后，逐项关闭「静音后自动结束录音」「转写后自动发送」「自动朗读回复」。关闭「增强输入框语音」会撤销公开输入插槽替换、立即恢复官方控件；朗读仍可独立启用。官方全部覆盖后可卸载本插件。不会根据版本号猜测官方能力，也不会偷偷修改官方配置。

公开接入点：`conversation.input.activity`（优先级 -100 的替换）、`plugins.bundle.config`（本插件设置）与 `conversation.session.header.actions`（当前会话朗读）。插件卸载撤销注册并等待录音、资源与远端观察释放。

## 开发

`npm install --ignore-scripts --legacy-peer-deps`，然后 `npm run build`。源码不依赖官方私有组件；维护的录音界面基于 MIT 代码，来源见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md。DSH 当前支持范围为 0.2.1-alpha.1 至 0.3.0 之前；发布包含 lib 产物，不要求安装端构建。

`npm test` 验证回复筛选。DSH 配套客户端行为和浏览器测试需要官方开发工作区，用 tests 中的运行脚本执行。它们测试静音、草稿冲突、取消、标准 ConfigForm 持久化、官方控件恢复及真实浏览器音频播放。

plugins.description: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Currently: dsh-model-fold, collapsible provider groups in the composer model picker.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugins

Plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

## Plugins

| Plugin | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`dsh-model-fold`](packages/dsh-model-fold) | 把模型选择器按供应商折叠起来 —— 每个供应商只占一行，点名称才展开它的模型。 |
| [`dsh-commandcode-quota`](packages/dsh-commandcode-quota) | Command Code 套餐额度面板（[上游](https://github.com/Jovan1666/commandcode-usage)的**最小化 UI 改进版**）—— 默认折叠成小芯片，点击展开。 |
| [`dsh-task-notify`](packages/dsh-task-notify) | 回合完成提醒 —— 一声轻提示音 + 右下角完成卡片（点击回到该会话）+ 可选 Windows 系统通知。 |

## Install

Each plugin is a DSH profile bundle that declares its own `dsh.bundle.patch`, so
one command installs and mounts it — no hand-editing of `cordis.patch.yml`.

```sh
# 模型选择器折叠
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LimiChan-2026/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-model-fold

# Command Code 额度面板（最小化 UI 版）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LimiChan-2026/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-commandcode-quota

# 回合完成提醒（提示音 + 右下角卡片 + 系统通知）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:LimiChan-2026/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/dsh-task-notify
```

Swap `desktop` for another profile name (`web`, …) if you are not using the
desktop app.

Then **fully quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness**, and reload the page. The client
bundle is loaded into the browser when the host starts, so a newly installed
plugin does not appear until then.

> `dsh` is not always on `PATH`. The Windows desktop app ships it at
> `<install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-model-fold
```

Then quit and reopen.

## Layout

```
packages/
  dsh-model-fold/          one plugin per directory
    index.js               host half
    client.js              browser half
    cordis.patch.yml       dsh.bundle.patch layer
    package.json           declares dsh.bundle + dsh.client
    test/                  jsdom behaviour tests
```

## Notes on the git install form

`github:<owner>/<repo>#path:/<subdir>` is what makes a monorepo work: pnpm clones
the repository and installs the package from that subdirectory. The `path:` must
point at the directory holding the plugin's `package.json`.

These plugins deliberately carry **no `scripts`, no `dependencies`, and no
`peerDependencies`**. That keeps the git install frictionless:

- No `prepare`/`build` script, so pnpm's build-script gate never blocks the
  install (a git-hosted plugin that builds on install needs its key added under
  `allowBuilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` first).
- No DSH peer range, so no version-compatibility exemption is required.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 深渊 ABYSSAL —— DSH (DeepSeek Harness) UI 皮肤：近黑深海底 + 单一生物荧光光源 + 玻璃面板。有控制台则进「设置 → 皮肤管理」卡片墙，没控制台也能自立运行；设置里「皮肤」下拉第一项「原生」即还原默认皮肤。
plugins.readme_text:
# 深渊 ABYSSAL · DSH UI 皮肤

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?logo=github)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![test](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> 近黑深海底 · 单一生物荧光光源 · 只透光不加厚边的玻璃

按 **`dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`** 公约实现的 DSH 皮肤包。装好后出现在
**设置 → 皮肤** 的卡片墙里，与其它皮肤并列，一键切换。

![外观矩阵](preview/abyssal-matrix.png)

## 运行模式：有控制台托管，没控制台自立

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **装了皮肤控制台** | 登记托管：出现在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 卡片墙里，由控制台负责互斥切换 / 持久化 / 故障隔离 |
| **没装控制台** | 等待 3 秒宽限后进入**自立模式**：自动应用外观，并在「设置 → 深渊」里给出开关与全部调节项 |

> **不会误判**：皮肤用运行时提供的 `ctx.inject(["uiSkinLoader"], cb)` **显式等待**控制台服务出现，
> 而不是在加载瞬间"看一眼有没有"。所以即使控制台比皮肤晚一步就绪，也仍然会正常登记（这是上一版踩过的坑）。

### 对控制台 / 脚本的接口

无论哪种模式，皮肤都暴露一个统一入口：

```js
window.__dshSkins["skins.abyssal"]
// { mode: "console" | "standalone", skinId, version,
//   isActive(), activate(), deactivate(), getSettings(), setSettings(patch) }
```

### 「原生」选项

设置面板里的 **「皮肤」下拉** 第一项是 **原生（默认观感）** —— 选中即还原默认皮肤：

- 有控制台时：调用控制台的 `switchTo("default")`（与控制台自己的"还原默认观感"同一路径），持久化归控制台；
- 自立模式时：直接关掉自己（`enabled=false`），立即卸下并**长期保持原生**，随时可再从下拉里选回本皮肤。

控制台是**可选**的第三方插件，不随本包分发。

## 这是一个 DSH 插件

本仓库是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件（皮肤类）。
按官方 README「Community and support」一节的要求，仓库已打上
[`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，便于在
[github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 被发现；
`package.json` 的 `keywords` 与 `dsh.skin.tags` 里同样带 `dsh-plugin`。

三种安装方式，任选其一：

| 方式 | 命令 / 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| git（无需下载包） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal` |
| 美化包 | 从 [Releases](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-abyssal/releases) 下 `ABYSSAL-UI-*.zip`，双击 `安装深渊皮肤.cmd` |
| 本地源码 | 见下方「安装 → B. 从源码装」 |

> 装完**必须重启 DSH**（插件包只在启动时进启动图），随后在 **设置 → 皮肤** 里一键切换。

## 外观

| 项 | 选项 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 底色 | 深海 / 午夜 / 墨黑 / 极地 | 深海 |
| 强调色 | 薄荷绿 / 冷青 / 靛紫 / 琥珀 / 珊瑚 | 薄荷绿 |
| 圆角密度 | 柔（14px）/ 均衡（原生）/ 紧（9px） | 柔 |
| 背景极光 | 强 / 柔 / 关 | 柔 |
| 胶片颗粒 | 开 / 关 | 开 |

4 × 5 × 3 × 3 × 2 = **360 种组合**，改档即时生效并跨重启保留
（皮肤自治：`localStorage`，键 `dsh.skin.abyssal.preferences.v1`）。

## 安装

### A. 用打包好的美化包（推荐给最终用户）

下载 release 里的 `ABYSSAL-UI-*.zip`，解压后双击 `安装深渊皮肤.cmd`。脚本会找到本机 DSH
（优先用你**正在运行**的那个），用官方途径装进 `desktop` profile，并把 `activeSkin` 切到本皮肤。

### B. 从源码装（开发）

```powershell
# 应用目录（默认装在当前用户的 LocalAppData 下；装在 Program Files 时改成对应路径）
$app = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness"
$cli = "$app\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"

# 以软链方式安装（改代码刷新即生效）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 卸载
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skin-abyssal
```

装完**必须重启 DSH**（新增插件包只在启动时进启动图）。切换皮肤也可以直接在
**设置 → 皮肤** 里点，不必手改配置。

### C. 从 1.0.2 及更早升级

1.0.3 换了命名空间：皮肤 id 统一为 `skins.abyssal`，包名统一为 `dsh-skin-abyssal`
（旧值带个人标识，见 1.0.2 的 package.json）。旧 id 不会自动继承，需重装一次：

```powershell
# 1) 完全退出 DSH —— 运行中 pnpm 会报 ERR_PNPM_EPERM（node_modules 被占用）

# 2) 查出旧包名并卸掉（这里不重复写出旧值）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop list | Select-String 'skin-abyssal'
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove <上面查到的旧包名>

# 3) 装新包
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 4) 把 profile patch 里任何 *.skin.abyssal 形式的旧 id 换成新 id（改前先备份）
$patch = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml"
Copy-Item $patch "$patch.bak"
(Get-Content $patch -Raw) -replace '[\w.-]+\.skin\.abyssal', 'skins.abyssal' |
  Set-Content $patch -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline
```

也可以直接双击美化包里的 `安装深渊皮肤.cmd` —— 它会把新包装上并把 `activeSkin` 切过来。

## 设计语言

1. **单光源** —— 整屏只有一组极光（左下强调色、右上靛紫、右下冷青），面板用半透明表面透出它，
   层级靠表面亮度而非阴影。
2. **发丝线分层** —— `rgba(158,196,255,.10)` 1px 描边 + 3% 白表面；永不加厚边。
3. **强调色纪律** —— 强调色只给「当前 / 可点 / 运行中」；成功 / 警告 / 危险保持独立语义色。
4. **仪表感** —— 元数据用等宽字体，数字 tabular。

## 实现要点

- **观感承载**：`theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖宿主公开 token ——
  `--dsw-alias-*`(107)、`--dsw-specific-*`(11)、`--dsw-menu-*`、`--dsw-linear-*`、
  `--dsw-radius-*`、`--dsw-static-neutral(-bluish)-*` 中性灰阶。覆盖一律带 `!important`
  （宿主有内联 token）。
- **驱动宿主的亮暗开关**：宿主的亮暗分支是 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，而
  `--dsw-specific-input-major` 这类表面 token 只在暗色分支里有定义。皮肤是纯暗色，
  所以激活时置位该属性、退出时还原 —— 否则未覆盖的表面会落进 light 分支。
- **浮层实色兜底**：`[role="dialog"] / [aria-modal] / [role="menu|listbox|tooltip"]`
  强制实色 + 直角，保证弹窗永远不透出正文（用标准语义属性，不碰宿主私有类名）。
- **背景**：极光与颗粒画在 `body` 背景上（多层 `radial-gradient` + 内联 SVG 噪声），
  **不新增浮层**，因此没有 z-index / 层叠上下文风险。
- **自有节点**：只有一个 `<style data-skn-abyssal-style>` 与 `body[data-skn-abyssal]` 标记。
- **生命周期**（公约 §4.3 / R8）：activate 的每项副作用都登记 disposer，teardown 幂等；
  `deactivate` / `skinCtx.signal` abort / fiber 意外 dispose 三路汇合，退出后 token 与节点全部还原。
- **设置面板**：经 `settings.section` 席位注册 React 组件，只在皮肤激活时出现。

## 自测

| 脚本 | 覆盖 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/browser-smoke.mjs` | 控制台路径：登记载荷 / 激活副作用 / **真实 CSS 层叠** / teardown | 31 |
| `tests/console-wait.mjs` | 控制台迟到 1 秒（不许误判自立）/ 始终不出现（自立 + 能回原生） | 18 |
| `tests/skin-selector.mjs` | 「皮肤」选择器：控制台模式走 switchTo / 自立模式走开关自己 | 9 |
| `tests/contrast.mjs` | **每个强调色 × 每种底**：文字/标签对比度 ≥4.5:1，亮底派生深档 | 31 |
| `tests/dependency-check.mjs` | 宿主半依赖自检 | 6 |

合计 **95 项断言**。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js          宿主半（空 apply：观感全在 client 半）
lib/client.js         皮肤本体（登记 / token 表 / 外观面板 / 生命周期）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（row id = 设置命名空间）
install/              一键安装 / 卸载脚本（美化包同款）
preview/              外观矩阵图 + 卡片预览 SVG
tests/browser-smoke.mjs
```

## 更新记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: dsh 插件：GitHub 日/周/月热榜监控 + 仓库详情中文描述与 README 节译（全程只读 GET）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-gh-trending

DSH（deepseek HARNESS）的 **GitHub 热榜监控**插件：在侧边栏「插件」下方增加一个入口，盯三件事 ——
**日榜 / 周榜 / 月榜各自怎么变**、**哪些仓库同时在多张榜上**、**本机第一次见到的仓库**。变化只记录在本插件面板里，不推任何外部通知。

对 github.com 全程**只读 GET**（每轮三发 = 三张榜各一发；只有传输类失败——连不上/超时——才对那一榜补发，单榜含补发最多 3 发，成功即停）：不带 key、不带 cookie、不 POST、不下载 zip、不 clone。
★ **第二十三轮（10-09）加的那一路有尾巴**：开了「全站高星」那一档 ⇒ 一轮最坏**四发**（三榜 + `/search/repositories` 一发），那一发**每轮上限一枚、不补发、不重试**，且**出厂关着** ⇒ 关着时上面那句"每轮三发"照旧一字成立；填了 GitHub 令牌时它也走同一条 `Authorization` 请求头那一路（只进请求头，不进 URL）。
★ **同日就地改判（用户裁定「开启的时候默认拉取一次」）**：把开关从关拨到开的那一趟 ⇒ **另加一发、当场花**（它不属于任何检查轮，所以那一轮的"四发"账不因为它变成五发）。口径钉三条：认的是库里的**转换**（已经开着再存一次 `true`、改别的键时顺带带上、连点 ⇒ 一律不派），**回执之前发完**（保存偏好的响应回来时那一批已经在库里也在载荷里，不留"点完了但结果在别处"），**发过就追帧**（坏轮的故障三格同样当场让界面看见）。匿名 search 一小时才 10 发 ⇒ 这一发是用户点下去授权的，不是插件自己起的。
★ **同日第二条裁定（「上次间隔时间范围内已经拉取过就不要拉取了」）**：那一趟从"必发"改成**当场决定发不发** —— 库里**最后一次成功取回**（`ok===true` 的 `at`）距此刻不到一份**检查间隔**（`prefs.intervalMin`，设置页那一格，出厂 60 分）⇒ 0 发，直接把库里那一批端上来（挡下的一趟不写库、不追帧，开关位跟着同一次回执上屏）。窗口不另造常数、界面上看得见的那个数字就是它；⚠️ **上一发是坏的（403 / 超时）时照旧重试** —— 判据吃 `at` 而不是 `lastFetchAt`，不许让用户为了重试去等下一轮检查；这一道闸**只挂在开启那一趟**，检查轮"每轮一发"的节律一字不动。
需要代理时走插件自己的 **CONNECT 隧道**（`lib/services/net.js`）：它不改本机任何代理设置，也不起监听端口，只在需要时向代理发起一条 `CONNECT github.com:443`，之后仍是标准 TLS + HTTPS GET。

**它是什么**

- **三张榜独立闸门**：日 / 周 / 月各一份状态，坏在哪一榜就只冻结哪一榜，绝不连冒横幅。
- **变化流水**：`board_enter / board_exit / board_move / first_on_board / renamed / rising_cross / cooling_cross / source_error / source_recover / baseline`（枚举与中文标签只在宿主侧 `lib/domain.js`，界面只查表）。位次挪动日/周 ≥3、月 ≥2 才记 `board_move`。
- **跨榜同现**：同时出现在 ≥2 张榜 = 持续升温，只剩 1 张 = 热度回落。三张榜在同一次检查里拿到，**这块分析零额外请求**。
- **明星仓库那一屏**（★ **第二十三轮（10-09）新增**，第七个页签）：答「哪些仓库反复上榜、谁在往上走」，原料**全在本地**（三榜这一轮的行 + 观测史 `seen`）⇒ **打开这一签零请求**；七列里「今日新增」只吃日榜、证据不足 3 轮时「在榜」那一列**整列置灰并说清为什么**（不藏列）。另有一档「全站高星」（`GET /search/repositories`）**出厂关着** —— ★ 10-09 改判：**点「开」的那一刻宿主立刻发一发**（不等下一轮检查），之后每轮最多一发、结果进缓存，关掉不删已攒的那批，详见「界面」那节；★ **10-10 第三条裁定**：开着时它那一批行**也参与描述列的现译**（与榜面共享那 12 发，关掉只是不上屏、不删译文）。
- **改名识别**：靠条目里的 `record_id` 认出同一个仓库换了 `owner/name` ⇒ 记 `renamed` 而不是「掉榜 + 新进」两笔假账。
- **项目收藏**（★ **第三十二轮（10-13）新增**，第八个页签）：三榜每一行的末尾、明星仓库那一屏的每一行、以及详情弹框的标题行，共**三处入口**摆同一枚 ☆（同一个组件、点它只改收藏 ⇒ 不跳转、不开弹框、不滚动）；收进来的仓库进「收藏」那一屏，七列 `# / 仓库 / 描述 / 语言 / 累计 ★（那一刻）/ 收藏于 / ★`（★ **第三十五轮（10-13）撤掉「这一轮」那一列**：用户指着屏上那一列说「去掉这个」，裁定「只删那一列，右侧那枚 ★（取消收藏的入口）照旧留着」⇒ 八列变七列，屏上不再有「在日榜 / 在月榜 / 未上榜」那个读数；宿主侧那一格派生、载荷格、相关判据与台账**一并撤干净，不留死码**）。★ **第三十三轮（10-13）描述那一格换成"本机已有的那一份中文"**：内置预译或已付过额度的现译，命中判据与榜面**同一个函数**（`lib/board-zh.js` 的 `descZhHits`，这一屏不重写第二遍）⇒ 周榜上有中文的那一行，收藏那一屏逐字同；中文长在**载荷那一行的 `descZh` 那一格**（★ 旧台账叫它「第 11 格」，那个序号吃的是「那一行共有十一格」—— 第三十五轮撤掉末尾的「这一轮」之后只剩十格，序号名一并作废，改叫格名），`desc` 那一格恒是收藏那一刻的**原文**（覆盖掉就没有第二处能证明"快照不刷新"了）。**这一路零出网、零新增额度**：那一格是**被动**的 —— 本机哪天译过那句原文它就上屏，没译过就念原文，屏上永远不欠一次请求。
  两条口径决定这一屏的形状：① **存的是收藏那一刻的快照，不是引用** —— 星数与描述**不随榜面刷新**（所以那一列表头写着「那一刻」，卡脚那句 note 把这件事说明白，要新值点仓库名走详情那条链）⇒ **打开这一签与收藏那一发都恒零出网**（★ 第三十二轮的出网账裁定：收藏这一路 0 发，不为了补快照去问 GitHub）；② ~~「这一轮」那一格是**宿主本地比出来的成品句**（拿收藏键与**同一帧**屏上那几批行比，命中念「在日榜 / 在周榜 / 在月榜 / 在明星」的优先级单值，没命中念「未上榜」），★ 比键时把榜行的 `renamedFrom` 一起铺进去 —— 仓库改名后不铺就会把"明明在榜"念成"未上榜"（用户收的默认：误念比缺念更糟）~~　★ **第三十五轮（10-13）这一条整条作废**（用户指着屏上那一列说「去掉这个」，裁定「只删那一列，右侧那枚 ★ 照旧留着」）：那一格连同它的**派生**一起撤 —— 优先级单值、`renamedFrom` 归一、`FAV_ON_BOARD_PRIORITY`、`FAV_COL_ON_BOARD`、`FAV_OFF_BOARD_CELL` 全部零出处（留入参就是死接口，`favs` 那套里有一条专门喂旧的那三档原料验它长不出那一格）⇒ 这一屏的形状现在**只剩上面那一条律**，屏上不再有「在日榜 / 未上榜」那个读数，收藏与榜面的关系只从「来自 <榜名>」那一枚出处牌读。
  收藏**不裁行、不设上限、不参与 LRU**（10-13 裁定：与 `repo` / `trans` 那两张表故意不同 —— 按时刻裁等于"收藏久了被系统悄悄删掉"），那一行的五格读数**由宿主派生**（`favSeedOf` 四路：三榜切片行 → 全站高星那一批 → 榜史 `seen` → 详情缓存 `repo` 表），浏览器只递 `{repo, action}` 两个字段；形状细节与判据见 `docs/design-spec.md` §8.15。
- **仓库详情按需取**：点榜面条目的仓库名才弹出一张详情对话框，并在这一下点击去 `api.github.com` 要元数据 + README，把 GitHub 自己给的字段拼成**一张结构化段表**（`sections[]` 四段：`项目是什么 / 热度与元数据 / 仓库自己怎么介绍它 / 中文摘要`，★ 第十一轮起替代旧的那一整句 `narrative`；段序、段名、哪句摆在哪一段、哪句算小字**全在宿主拼死**，客户端只按 `kind` 摆），并探测仓库**自己写的**中文 README（★ `readmeSource` **五档**：`zh_default` 默认 README 本身就是中文 / `zh_file` 仓库另写了一份中文 README（★ **第十五轮起这一档有两条路**：根目录列表里命中 `README-zh_CN.md` 那类，**或**默认篇首屏那行语言切换里写着的相对路径命中（真机 `docs/i18n/README.zh-CN.md` 那一类，根目录压根没有）—— 两条路共用同一发正文请求，**编排仍是 4 发封顶**） / **`zh_section` 默认篇是外文但整篇里嵌着一段中文小节**（第十一轮新增，吃已经在手的那份正文，**零额外请求**）/ `en_default` 只有英文篇 / `none` 没 README）。
  描述那一句若命中内置离线词表，会在「项目是什么」那一段里**多**一个块「中文描述（内置离线预译 · <日期>，不是现译）」，原文紧跟着另起一块照给；没命中而现译开关开着时，换成「中文描述（<这一行当初是谁译的> · <日期 时刻>）」（`免费接口` / `百度` / `腾讯` / `阿里` / `模型现译` 五选一，库里旧行还可能有历史档名 `官方接口`，§8.4），**原文照样另起一块**（译文不替换仓库自己写的那句）。
- **描述列中文（内置离线预译表，`lib/desc-zh.js`）**：榜面与详情里的仓库描述，命中表里的就给一句**人工预译**的中文，没命中就只显示原文。三条口径：

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：任务执行到第 X 步起，每 Y 步往智能体自己的上下文里注入一次自定义消息（共 Z 次，文案支持 {{step}} 占位），并可在用户消息末尾追加一句话；带总开关，全部在设置页配置。Scheduled context injection for DSH agents.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-insert-context

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that inserts context into an agent **during** a task, on a schedule
you define. Three switches, all configured from DSH's Settings page:

0. **Master switch** (`enabled`, **on by default**) — when off the plugin is completely inert: no
   rule message, no append, and the step counter stops too, so switching it back on resumes the
   schedule where it stopped instead of firing every rule the silent steps had already passed.
1. **Rule injection** — a rule says *from step X, every Y steps, Z times, with this text*. When the
   agent's current step number is one of the steps the rule hits, the text is injected as one extra
   context message. `{{step}}` in the text is replaced by the current step number.
2. **Append to every user message** — one sentence is appended to the end of each user message you
   send. **Off by default**; turn it on in Settings if you want it. A second switch,
   **append to subagents** (`appendSubagents`, also off by default), decides whether messages *sent
   to subagents* (via `delegate` / `send_message`) get the append too — they are tagged as user
   messages just like yours, so without this switch they would be indistinguishable. A third switch,
   **append to the first message only** (`appendFirstOnly`, **on by default**), turns the append
   into a one-shot: only the first user message of the conversation carries the sentence, every
   later user message is left untouched.

Either behaviour can be turned off (an empty rule list injects nothing; `userAppend: false` stops
the append — the shipped default), and nothing is injected unless a rule or the append is actually
configured.

## Rules

A rule is `{ start, every, repeat, text }`. Its **hit set** is

```
start, start + every, start + 2·every, … , start + (repeat − 1)·every     ← exactly `repeat` hits
start, start + every, start + 2·every, …                                  ← when `repeat` is 0 (unlimited)
```

| rule | hits |
|---|---|
| `{ start: 10, every: 10, repeat: 0 }` | 10, 20, 30, 40, … forever (**unlimited**) |
| `{ start: 5, every: 5, repeat: 9 }` | 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45 |
| `{ start: 60, every: 10, repeat: 5 }` | 60, 70, 80, 90, 100 |

`repeat: 0` is the special value for **unlimited**: from `start` onwards the rule fires on every
`every`-th step and never stops (`repeat` is validated as 0–1000, where 0 means unlimited). The
Settings page previews an unlimited rule as `将注入第 10,20,30,… 步（无限次）` — the preview lists the
first 10 hits and never walks an endless list.

So free-form intervals are possible — inject on 5, 10, 15 … 50 and then on 60, 70 … 100 by listing
two rules. Rules are independent: one agent can be hit by any number of them.

`{{step}}` is the **only** supported placeholder, and it is only recognised in a rule's `text`
(not in `appendText`). It is replaced by the current step number of that agent's counter — the same
counter described under *Step counting* below. Any other `{{…}}` is left in the text verbatim and
logged as a warning by the host (prefix `insert-context:`), never silently swallowed:

```
insert-context: unknown placeholder {{turn}} in rules[0].text; it is injected verbatim (only {{step}} is supported)
```

### Several rules on the same step

If one step hits several rules, they are **merged into a single injected message**: each hit rule
contributes one paragraph with its own `{{step}}` filled in, and the paragraphs are joined with a
newline in the order the rules appear in the settings list (`rules[0]` first). One hit — one
message, no matter how many rules matched. Reordering the rows on the Settings page therefore
reorders the paragraphs.

### Step counting

The counter is **per agent**, keyed by the agent id of the step payload, and it is dropped when that
agent is disposed (`agent/disposed`). Steps that are rejected downstream are not counted, and neither
are steps taken while the master switch (`enabled`) is off — the counter simply freezes, so switching
the plugin back on resumes the schedule where it stopped. There is
**no layer filtering**: a dispatcher and each of its subagents keep separate counters, so a subagent
that is on its 5th step is hit by `{ start: 5, every: 5, repeat: 9 }` even if its parent is on step
50. Counting starts from the moment the plugin is mounted/active.

### Duplicate suppression

If a step already appended the sentence to a user message (behaviour 2), no rule message is injected
for that same step — the appended sentence already ends the batch, and a second copy is noise.

### 追加去重（Append dedup）

在 `userAppend` 开启时，每次追加前都会检查消息尾部：如果用户消息的最后一个文本块已经
以 `appendText` 结尾（尾部完全匹配），本次不再追加，避免同一句话连续出现两遍。去重只
跳过已命中的那条消息，不影响同一批里的其他消息；若本步没有实际追加任何内容，规则
消息仍按正常计划注入。

Before appending with `userAppend` on, the plugin checks the message tail: if the last text block of a
user message already ends with `appendText` (exact tail match), that message is skipped — the sentence
won't appear twice at the end of one message. Only the matched message is skipped; other messages in
the same batch are still appended. If nothing was actually appended this step, rule messages are
injected on schedule.

## Defaults

The built-in default `rules` holds **exactly one rule** — a short nudge, from step 10, every 10
steps, unlimited:

| # | rule | text |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `{ start: 10, every: 10, repeat: 0 }` (unlimited) | `现在是第 {{step}} 步，注意任务收敛进度。` |

About that wording:

- it is the **plain literal** the user asked for — no `【 … 】` brackets and no compression sentence;
- the tone check holds: it contains none of 必须 / 不许 / 立刻, and it puts no pressure on the user;
- it is **one clause**: the step number, then what to watch. The previous default carried a second
  clause (`如果还有没做完的事情，就把事做完再说吧`) to cancel the hurry its first clause
  (`用户催你搞快点啦`) created; with the pressure removed there is nothing left to cancel, so the
  conditional clause and the reasoning it needed are gone with it.
- it stays **short** on purpose. The reminder is reread on every hit, and this host has **no
  session-level turn budget or hard gate**, so a wording that explains *when to stop* spends tokens
  on every hit while shaping the reply more than it helps. A nudge that names the thing to watch
  (`任务收敛进度`) leaves the judgement where it belongs — with the agent, on the task at hand.

The built-in default `appendText` is used only when you turn the append switch on: it asks for a
readable answer without a replay of the process, and the square brackets are part of the text.

> [注：回复不复述过程，结构清晰可读性好。]

Both the append switch and the appended line are **off by default** (`userAppend: false`): the
shipped default is just the every-10-steps injection above. When you do turn the append on, it
appends to the **first user message only** — `appendFirstOnly` is **on by default**, because the
notice is a one-off instruction; repeating it on every message only spends tokens.

Older/longer wordings the user has used are **not defaults** — they are kept here as copy-paste
examples only (paste one into a new row on the Settings page if you want it):

| rule (example, not a default) | text |
|---|---|
| `{ start: 10, every: 10, repeat: 0 }` | `【这是第 {{step}} 步。思考：验收清单已完成则收工交付，未完成则继续。压缩时不保留本括号内的内容。】` |
| `{ start: 10, every: 10, repeat: 0 }` | `【这是第 {{step}} 步。按需收敛：这一轮结束后，会不会改变验收标准里某一条的判定？一条都不变，就收工交付当前结果；要继续，就把“下一步要改变哪一条判定”写清楚。已通过的验证不必再确认一遍。这一轮没能收尾时（被中断、或还需要继续），交付已完成部分 + 未完成清单（原因 / 下次继续的第一步），状态标 budget-limited，不要拿残缺当完成。压缩时不保留本括号内的内容。】` |
| `{ start: 60, every: 10, repeat: 5 }` | `这是第 {{step}} 步。按边界收尾：交付“已完成 / 未完成 / 未完成原因 / 下次继续的第一步”，状态标 budget-limited，不许用不完整的答案冒充完成。` |

Two of those examples carry a **compression-time instruction** in their tail:
`压缩时不保留本括号内的内容。` The notice is a one-off nudge for that step, not a fact to deliver, so
a context compaction need not copy it into a folded summary — leaving it there only spends tokens.
That instruction covers the bracketed reminder itself only; it says nothing about dropping
*unverified / not-covered* items from a delivery, which the rules above still require.

## How it works

The plugin listens on the host event `agent/pre-step`. It awaits the downstream decis

# dsh-plugin-compat-check

如果你觉得这个项目有用或有趣，欢迎点个 [Star ⭐](https://github.com/lcy0121/dsh-plugin-compat-check) 支持一下！

检查**已安装的 DSH 插件**与目标 DSH 版本的兼容性，提供源码位置、依据和覆盖限制。声明放行、激活成功不等于业务功能正常。

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md)

## 版本与入口

npm `latest` 为 **0.1.4**，支持 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`。本次补丁包含激活前提说明、Origin 有效端口校验、npm 子目录元数据及仓库工程诊断。发布、验证与后续工作见 [Plan](docs/Plan.md)。

| 入口 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| npm 插件 | 兼容性标签、插件详情发现/角标、`compat_check` 工具与 skill provider |
| 仓库 CLI | 检查已装插件，读取已有探针或显式启动临时宿主 |
| 仓库安装检查 | 在临时 profile 中安装、启动并检查一个安装规格 |
| skill | 指导 agent 使用同一工具或 CLI；[交付说明](skill/README.md) |

这些入口共享判定内核，只有相同输入和观测证据才应得到相同结果。npm 包**没有 CLI bin**，不支持 `npx dsh-plugin-compat-check`。

## 界面示例

记录的详情页截图，仅展示报告呈现，不是完整兼容认证：

![部分可用：源码位置、影响与依据](plugin/assets/compat-detail-partial.png)
![声明冲突：区分工具推断与宿主提示](plugin/assets/compat-detail-declared.png)

## 快速开始

### 插件

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-compat-check
```

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 入口：**更多 → 设置 → 内置插件 → 兼容性**。agent 可调用 `compat_check`。请选择实际 profile，不默认使用 desktop。

当前源码（尚未发布）增加：插件搜索、组合筛选、折叠发现、完整故障报告预览/复制，以及基于既有差分的“本次新增风险”视图。各发现提供“下一步核实”；报告保留确定性、影响依据和覆盖限制，复制前请预览敏感信息。源码构建安装及验收见 [Plan](docs/Plan.md#57-核实步骤与面板体验验收)。

当前源码另提供独立的“升级前兼容性预检”：在兼容性页输入“目标 DSH 版本”，点击“运行升级预检”；agent 可调用 `compat_check({"upgradeTo":"0.2.1-rc.2"})`，需要时另指定实际 `profile`。宿主版本自动作为当前版本；预检与普通体检报告分开展示，不复用普通报告的观测、缓存或基线。此源码增量尚未发布，使用前须按下述说明构建完整 tgz。

源码另修复同名插件 alias 覆盖：重复身份明确无法判定并保留基线。普通报告展示目标 DSH、参考目录版本/摘要及验收范围，未知/未来版本和自定义目录提示未认证；[目录治理流程](docs/catalog-governance.md)要求来源核验、API差分、规则复核及真实验收。仓库 YAML 工具依赖已升级修复公告；这些改动尚未发布。

尚未发布的源码还限制绑定探针最多5分钟的未来时钟偏差；超范围时撤回该探针证据并说明原因。CI已增加独立依赖安全门禁，开发者可运行 `npm run security:dependencies`，详见[依赖安全说明](docs/dependency-security.md)。

### 仓库 CLI

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lcy0121/dsh-plugin-compat-check.git
cd dsh-plugin-compat-check
npm ci --ignore-scripts
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> --no-baseline
node bin/compat-check.mjs --help
```

| 选项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `--nm <dir>` | 必需；接受 profile 或 node_modules 目录 |
| `--probe <json>` / `--probe-boot` | 读取已有观测，或显式启动临时宿主；同时给时文件优先 |
| `--dsh-version <v>` | 声明判断与目录选择的目标版本，显式值优先 |
| `--json` / `--quiet` | 完整 JSON / 仅总结行 |
| `--no-baseline` / `--dry-run` | 禁止基线读写 / 只比较不写入 |
| `--baseline-file <path>` | 指定基线文件 |
| `--issue-report` | 默认脱敏 Markdown；不读写基线，与 json/quiet 互斥 |
| `--rules <json>` / `--catalog <json>` | 覆盖规则 / API 目录 |
| `--probe-timeout <秒>` / `--probe-keep-dir <dir>` | 启动等待默认40秒 / 将探针证据留至显式私有目录 |
| `--help` / `--version` | 完整帮助 / 工具版本，无需目标目录 |

`--issue-report` 输出仍保留插件名与包内相对路径，分享前须预览；原始日志、探针和基线不导出，不自动发帖。私有现场和工程诊断也不能直接当作可分享报告。

### 升级前兼容性预检（当前源码）

```bash
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> --dsh-version 0.2.0-rc.2 --upgrade-to 0.2.1-rc.2 --json
```

此模式必须显式提供当前精确版本（`--dsh-version`）和目标精确版本（`--upgrade-to`）；省略 `--json` 可读普通文本。两端目前仅支持有明确 API 目录的 **0.2.0-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.2**。未知版本或版本范围返回 `status=unsupported-version`、退出3并提示未认证，不回退到邻近目录。npm 插件包没有 CLI，CLI 仍从仓库运行。

预检对同一组已装插件的私有字节副本联合静态提取一次，再按两个版本的目录及声明策略独立判定；报告包含制品 SHA-256、两端目录文件/来源/摘要、当前与目标报告、差异及覆盖限制。它不执行插件、不安装或升级宿主，不读取旁置/环境探针、运行时面、profile 豁免、缓存或基线，也不写产品状态。捕获输入有预算并作两次一致性观察，不是 OS 原子快照。

预检退出码专指**新增/变重风险**：0=没有新增或变重，1=存在非致命新增/变重，2=含致命新增/变重，3=预检不可用。已有问题可能不变，目标完整结论另见 `targetReport`；**退出0不等于目标可用或升级后业务通过**。保留 certainty/impactBasis、coverage/vacuous、扫描不完整及客户端待验证信息。此模式拒绝探针/启动、规则/目录覆盖、基线文件、dry-run、quiet 和故障报告参数；可带无操作的 `--no-baseline`。契约与复现见 [Plan §2.7](docs/Plan.md#27-升级前静态预检契约)、[§5.8](docs/Plan.md#58-升级前预检验收与复现)。

### 固定样本静态批量检查（仓库工具）

```bash
node tools/static-batch.mjs --manifest test/fixtures/static-batch.json > batch.json
node tools/static-batch.mjs --manifest test/fixtures/static-batch.json --previous batch.json > next.json
node tools/static-batch.mjs --hash <本地包目录>
```

清单锁定包名、精确版本及完整文件树 SHA-256；先校验私有副本，再用同一内核独立扫描。最多16项、每项10秒、整批60秒，不装包、不执行目标、不读探针或基线。退出0/1/2保留静态结论，3表示清单、哈希、预算或工具错误；自带合成队列预期退出2。所有结果标记“待作者复核”，保留覆盖有限、空洞结论和扫描不完整信息，不能当作业务认证。增量比较始终重新扫描；制品、工具源码、规则、目录、目标版本或预算变化时不比较。分享 JSON 前须预览。

清单格式、指纹算法及权限/成本取舍见 [Plan §2.5](docs/Plan.md#25-有限静态批量契约)。手动 Action [static-batch.yml](.github/workflows/static-batch.yml)仅扫描仓库内固定公开样本，仓库权限只读；当前未部署远程端点或结果缓存，也不随 npm 插件分发。

### 安装检查与独立 skill

```bash
node bin/check-install.mjs <spec> --json
./dsh-plugin-compat-check.sh <spec> --json
./dsh-plugin-compat-check.sh --install-skill
```

安装检查需要 Node、DSH、pnpm；接受 DSH 支持的 npm/GitHub/git/file 规格，支持 `--keep`、`--timeout`（默认30秒）。安装可能联网，并会启动宿主、执行目标插件，**临时 profile 不是 OS 沙箱**。独立 skill 已存在时需 `--force` 才覆盖，位置见 [skill 说明](skill/README.md)。

仓库根是 private 开发工作区，不是可激活的插件包。测试源码请先打完整 tgz，再让 DSH 安装；不要将根 GitHub spec 或裸 `plugin/` 复制等同于完整产物。[源码打包方法](plugin/README.md#从源码构建安装)。

## 理解结果与边界

普通 CLI/Node 安装检查退出码：**0** 未发现问题、**1** 部分可用或未知、**2** 不兼容或安装 peer 闸门拒绝、**3** 输入/执行错误，无法判定。升级预检采用上文的差异退出码。shell 进入 Node 前仍有用法/内核错误码；自动化使用 Node 入口并检查 `status`。

- 始终转述 `certainty`、`impactBasis`、`coverage` 和 `vacuous`；未知、未采样和省略键不等于缺失，目录不是运行时面。客户端功能须另验收。
- 默认静态 CLI 不启动 DSH、不安装目标包；宿主体检不调用外部命令或联网，使用有预算的分析 worker。默认会写自身基线，一次性检查加 `--no-baseline`。
- 方法级分析基于有界 Babel AST/包内值流，动态行为仍有限；声明与 API 风险不保证业务行为。现代观测须匹配 profile、版本和时效，不能借用另一 profile 的证据。
- 自 0.1.3 起支持新版 DSH 声明规则、精确兼容豁免及 rc.2 目录；未来 DSH 版本未经认证。已有 macOS/Linux 的限定验证，Windows 待真实验收。[完整契约与限制](docs/Plan.md#2-现行判定与集成契约)。

## 开发与文档

```bash
npm test
npm run format:check
node tools/doc-check.mjs
npm run notices:check
node plugin/scripts/prepublish-check.mjs
node tools/meta-check.mjs --json
```

默认套件不启动真实 DSH/模型；打包回归使用私有空缓存安装，需要 npm registry。`doc-check` 不递归跑测试；元数据核验需要 gh/npm 和联网，未发布 README 差异为 notice，取数失败不是通过。发布前检查本身不发布版本。

[Plan：契约、验证与待办](docs/Plan.md) · [current-state.json：计数与证据](docs/current-state.json) · [规则](rules/README.md) · [skill](skill/README.md)。工程诊断、独立业务度量及显式模型测试的命令与权限见 [复现指南](docs/Plan.md#5-验证记录与复现)，这些开发工具不随 npm 插件分发。

项目已收录于：

- [Awesome DSH Plugin（主目录）](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
- [Awesome DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness)
- [dsh.works 插件目录](https://github.com/dshworks/awesome-dsh-plugins)
- [Bruce 的 Awesome DSH Plugins](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin)
- [1024 生态目录](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins)（[1024 Store](https://deepseek1024.com) 展示）

收录不等于兼容性认证；1024 Store 的 npm 安装方式仍待上游修复，状态见 [Plan](docs/Plan.md)。

固定真实插件故障回归仅用于仓库开发，默认两轮，需真实DSH/Chrome和联网安装：

```bash
node tools/real-regression.mjs --live --out-dir <空证据目录>
node tools/real-regression.mjs --replay <证据根目录>
```

绿色表示固定正常/故障/恢复重现，仍保留分模式FP/FN；范围和资源预算见 [Plan](docs/Plan.md#56-真实插件故障回归验收与复现)。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: puts a Settings row in the sidebar header, immediately before Plugins, and opens the native Settings panel in one click.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-settings-button

DSH plugin: puts a **Settings** row in the sidebar header, immediately **before Plugins**, opening the native Settings panel in one click.

```
┌─ sidebar ─────────────────┐
│  ⚙  Settings   ← new row
│  ⊛  Plugins
│  ⏱  Schedules
└───────────────────────────┘
```

## What it does

Registers one entry in the sidebar's own `sidebar.panellist` seat with `order: -10` (Plugins ships at `0`, Schedules at `10`), so the row lands first and the shipped sidebar draws it: native geometry, hover, focus ring, collapsed-rail icon and tooltip, localized label. A click opens the same panel as `Ctrl+,` / `⌘+,`.

## How it works

**The click is intercepted.** `sidebar.panellist` is the seat for *main panels* — ui-sidebar turns each entry into a button whose `onClick` calls `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)`, and that id must address a component in the layout's keyed `main` slot. Settings is not a panel but a modal owned by ui-settings-general, and `selectPanel` throws for an unknown key. So one capture-phase listener on `document` takes the click above the React root (React 18 delegates to the container) and opens Settings instead. It re-resolves the row's enclosing `button` on every click, so the icon, the label and the button's padding all count as the row.

**Settings is opened through the shortcut registry.** `settings.open` is the only programmatic door: the panel's open state is private to ui-settings-general, and the `settings.launcher` seat that receives `openSettings` is a `single` slot already occupied by the account menu. `ctx.shortcuts.registry.invoke(id, context)` is the path the native Electron menu uses to run a command without its key binding. It is called with `modal: null` on purpose — the registry's modal guard would otherwise swallow the call whenever any `[role="menu"]` is mounted, and the action is idempotent (`open: true`) so the panel cannot be toggled shut by accident.

**No silent failures.** Every degraded path returns a short reason, shown in a Toast and logged to the console. DevTools is available on **F12**.

## Install

```powershell
# Windows, using the app's own CLI:
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-folder-or-tgz>

dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-sidebar-settings-button   # uninstall
```

`dsh plugin add` is `pnpm add` inside the profile plus a `dsh.profile.bundles` reconcile, so a package declaring `dsh.bundle` joins the layer list automatically. A folder install is a `link:`, which is why this checkout stays the single source of truth.

## Verify

```powershell
node test/bundle.test.mjs                      # 6 tests: registration, order, whole-row click, Toast, degradations
node --check src/index.js; node --check client/bundle.js
```

Live check — the client slot inspector must list our entry before `plugins`:

```
cordis_inspect_query(platform: "client", provider: "Slots",
                     method: "listSubTree", input: { root: "sidebar.panellist" })
```

## Limits

- The **avatar menu's "Settings" item stays** — it belongs to another plugin's React tree. The header row is an additional, always-visible entry point.
- The row's `id` addresses **no main panel**; the click interception is the only thing keeping `selectPanel` from throwing. If ui-sidebar ever switches to `onClickCapture`, that interception needs rework (the test only covers our side).
- The sidebar passes `{ size, active }`; only `size` is used, and the row is never highlighted — Settings is not a panel.

## Layout

No build step: the browser half is a plain classic script calling `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. Its only `require`s are platform modules (`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), so `dsh.client.inject` / `dsh.client.external` are unnecessary.

```
src/index.js        host half — no-op stub; exists so dsh-client-modules finds the browser bundle
client/bundle.js    the entire feature
cordis.patch.yml    inserts the Loader entry into the profile composition
test/bundle.test.mjs
```

plugins.description: Read-only Stripe billing and customer tools for DeepSeek Harness with Restricted API Key support
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-stripe

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A read-only Stripe billing and customer plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). It gives agents bounded visibility into account status, customers, products, subscriptions, invoices, and payment intent outcomes.

The plugin is deliberately read-only. It never creates, updates, cancels, refunds, or deletes Stripe resources, and it does not return card, payment method, client secret, raw metadata, invoice PDF, or hosted invoice URL fields.

## Install

~~~sh
npm install @libai168/dsh-tool-stripe
~~~

Use a Stripe Restricted API Key with read-only permissions, preferably an rk_test or rk_live key scoped to only the resources this deployment needs. Do not use a full secret key when a restricted key is sufficient, and never commit a key.

## Configuration

~~~yaml
- name: '@libai168/dsh-tool-stripe'
  config:
    apiKey: 'rk_test_replace_with_a_read_only_key'
    # baseUrl: 'https://api.stripe.com'
    # apiVersion: '2025-06-30.basil'
    # timeoutMs: 15000
~~~

The client uses Stripe's Basic authentication and cursor pagination. Full example: [examples/cordis.yml](examples/cordis.yml).

The `baseUrl` override must be an absolute `http://` or `https://` root URL. Only publicly reachable hosts are allowed: localhost, loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, multicast, reserved/documentation/benchmark ranges, and every IANA special-purpose block are rejected, and a hostname whose DNS results contain any such address fails closed before the request is sent. Credentials, query strings, fragments, and non-root paths are not allowed.

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| stripe_auth_test | Verify the key and return safe account status fields | read |
| stripe_list_customers | List customers with an optional email filter | read |
| stripe_list_products | List active/inactive products without raw metadata | read |
| stripe_list_prices | List prices by product, active state, type, or currency without raw metadata | read |
| stripe_list_subscriptions | List subscriptions by customer, status, or price | read |
| stripe_list_invoices | List invoices and bounded amount/status fields | read |
| stripe_list_payment_intents | List payment outcomes without card or client-secret fields | read |

Every list uses Stripe cursor pagination with limit, starting_after, and ending_before. Limits are clamped to 1-100.

stripe_list_prices returns only an allowlisted view of each Price: ID, product, currency, integer/decimal unit amount, active state, type, recurring interval, billing scheme, tax behavior, nickname, and creation time. It does not return metadata, tiers, transform quantities, payment links, or secret fields.

## Security contract

- The API key is sent only in the Basic Authorization header and never appears in tool output, rendering, presentation cards, or error text.
- Read-only Restricted API Key permissions are the deployment boundary. The plugin does not attempt to enforce permissions by sending write requests.
- Canonical outputs use explicit field allowlists. Payment methods, cards, client secrets, source tokens, raw metadata, invoice PDFs, and hosted invoice links are excluded.
- Requests honor timeoutMs and the tool execution AbortSignal. 401/403/429 and server failures remain infrastructure errors so callers can stop or retry deliberately; there is no automatic financial-request retry.
- Customer names/emails and billing fields are external data. Treat them as untrusted context and share only when the task requires it.


# Inspect price and recurring plan options
stripe_list_prices({ productId: 'prod_id', active: true, type: 'recurring', currency: 'usd', limit: 20 })

## Model Experience

The model can start with stripe_auth_test, then use list tools with a small limit. It should pass the nextCursor returned by the previous page as starting_after. List outputs contain identifiers, statuses, timestamps, amounts, and currencies; they do not contain payment credentials or raw Stripe objects.

## Known Limitations and Deferred Work

- This release is read-only and does not create or mutate billing resources.
- It does not retrieve individual payment methods, card details, invoice PDFs, hosted invoice URLs, or raw event payloads.
- Cursor pagination is one page per tool call; callers must explicitly request the next cursor.
- A Restricted API Key may not have access to every resource; Stripe permissions and account scope are configured outside the plugin.

## Development

~~~sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm pack --dry-run
~~~

See [DEVELOPMENT.md](DEVELOPMENT.md) for endpoint mapping and release checks.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tool-context7

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

[Context7](https://context7.com) up-to-date documentation integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) as a Cordis plugin. The agent can search libraries, pull current documentation snippets for a library ID, and search docs across libraries — so answers use current APIs instead of outdated training data.

## Install

```sh
npm install @libai168/dsh-tool-context7
```

Requires `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (^4.0.1) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (^0.1.0-rc.6) as peer dependencies.

## Configuration

```yaml
- name: 'github:LJH-snow/dsh-tool-context7'
  config:
    # baseUrl: 'https://context7.com/api'
    # apiKeyEnv: 'CONTEXT7_API_KEY'
    # timeoutMs: 30000
```

The API key is optional: without one, requests run in Context7's public mode with lower rate limits. When configured, the plugin reads the key (format `ctx7sk-...`) from the environment variable named by `apiKeyEnv` (default: `CONTEXT7_API_KEY`). Do not put a usable key in source, examples, tests, or committed configuration. Create the key in the Context7 dashboard.

The `baseUrl` override must be an absolute `http://` or `https://` root URL. Only publicly reachable hosts are allowed: localhost, loopback, private, link-local, CGNAT, multicast, reserved/documentation/benchmark ranges, and every IANA special-purpose block are rejected, and a hostname whose DNS results contain any such address fails closed before the request is sent. Credentials, query strings, fragments, and non-root paths are not allowed.

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Write |
|---|---|---|
| `context7_auth_test` | Verify access and report whether a key is configured | No |
| `context7_search_libraries` | Search libraries by name and return library IDs | No |
| `context7_get_library_docs` | Get documentation snippets for one library ID | No |
| `context7_search_docs` | Search docs across libraries with optional library/version/language hints | No |

## Security contract

- The API key is read from an environment variable at plugin startup and is never included in tool output or rendered text; without a key, requests simply omit the authorization header.
- Library results are capped at 20 entries; docs responses at 12 snippets (8 code + 8 info for search) with 6,000 characters per snippet and 20,000 characters per response, flagged via `truncated`.
- All tools are read-only; there are no write, delete, or account-management tools.
- The client passes caller cancellation signals through to `fetch` and uses a 30-second timeout by default.
- API failures are normalized into `{ ok: false, reason }` or `{ found: false, reason }` tool results.

## API scope

This version uses the Context7 v2/v3 endpoints verified against the official SDK source: `GET /v2/libs/search`, `GET /v2/context`, and `GET /v3/search` (repeated `library` params for up to four library hints). There is no documented write surface, so none is implemented.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm pack --dry-run
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)
